author: TotallyBeast
body: This is a complaint against the unjustified & unwarranted actions by Moderator named "Nathy". My son and his friend are minors using this peer-to-peer website, playing on a server together under our IP Network and were "banned" because of absolutely false accusations of spleefing and ban-evading. According to Nathy, he says "In regards to the ban evading, you and _Hypershock_ were using the same IP", which as anyone knows is very plausible because we have a network router in our household, which I'm sure a lot of other households do too, so more than one person can be under the same IP.  What's more upsetting is Nathy's request which states "would you be able to provide a photo of the two of you, or a video of you playing together, or possibly add me on skype @nathanpatricbrown so I can see that you are two separate people". As a parent, this statement sets off criminal warning signs and privacy issues! An inquiry like this should never happen and it will be reported to local authorities if action is not taken to prevent inappropriate requests like this from happening in the future. It is so inappropriate that Nathy should be banned as a moderator and his access revoked.
